title: A date request and an answered planning question

messages.body: Our agreed details are June 12, 2027, Juniper Hall, and 36 guests. Are there any dietary restrictions?
Could we move the event to June 19, 2027 instead? The 36 guests and Juniper Hall would stay the same.
I need to check availability for June 19. The change is not confirmed; June 12 remains our agreed date for now.
